interpretation.suitable_for_dashboard_decision_support: Calibrated probabilities may be shown as a supporting, approximate risk indicator, but should NOT be presented to a SOC analyst as a statistically guaranteed likelihood -- calibration here is fit on validation and only checked (not re-fit) on test, the ECE gap between validation and test reflects the same chronological prevalence shift documented in Phase 8A, and no confidence interval or statistical guarantee is computed anywhere in this stack. Ranking (PR-AUC/ROC-AUC, unaffected by calibration) remains the more defensible basis for prioritization than the raw calibrated probability value taken literally.
